title:
Endpoint for serving type system metadata and source code for the SDK clients (JavaScript and Python).

Root path is `/typesys/8/`:
 - `names.json` - JSON array of all type names
 - `type.language.json` - JSON serialized TypeMeta for _type_ in _language_
 - `type.actionEngine.language` - implementation code for _type_ in _language_ for _actionEngine_
 - `bundle/name.json` - deliver the resource bundle _name_ as defined by prior requests
name: Typesys.Service
